newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Indian for drugs smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Indian for drugs smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded an Indian heroin smuggler, the third person executed on drugs charges over the past week.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said a court found the man guilty of smuggling an unspecified quantity of heroin into the conservative kingdom.
The execution in the western port city of Jeddah raised to 77 the number of people executed by the sword in Saudi Arabia this year.
The Indian was the twelfth person beheaded on drugs charges over the past month.
Saudi Arabia applies Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug traffickers and other criminals. A total of 68 people were beheaded in 1996.
